_note: B-68. Backup write lever on the mock tenant state. Mock only; no backup product is called. The daily review that proposes it is read-only (D6-24).

levers.name: backup.retry-job
levers.description: Ask for one failed or missed backup job of the client to be run again. Mock of a backup product's retry call; records a request in the client's own state.

job_id.description: The failed or missed backup job to run again, e.g. BJ-1003

impact.L1: Files or mail missed by last night's backup are protected today, not found missing in a restore; a retry on a busy server can slow it for the people using it.
impact.L2: The client's recovery point is repaired the same day; a retry at the wrong hour can load a production server or the office internet link.
impact.L3: A failed backup is fixed within the day, one request per job however many nights it failed; every retry is a registered, approved and audited change.
impact.L4: A retry names a job of one client's own backup only, so one office's backup is never touched for another's.
